newsitem.title: CANADA: Ventra says Tarxien bid expires.
newsitem.headline: Ventra says Tarxien bid expires.

text.p: Ventra Group Inc said on Tuesday its offer to buy Tarxien Corp expired at midnight on November 18 without the minimum tender condition of 50.1 percent of the Tarxien shares being tendered.
No Tarxien shares will be taken up and paid for, Ventra said. All shares will be returned to the shareholders who tendered to the Ventra offer.

Tarxien, an auto parts company, said on Monday that it signed an amended agreement with Gecamex Technologies Inc under which it will recommend acceptance of an increased takeover offer of C$15.40 a share, up from from C$14.10.
